candidate_news.summary: Democratic nominee Evan Snyder, unopposed in the primary and described by county Democrats as a placeholder, withdrew June 22. Independent Jodi Borello (former Republican, independent since March 2026) made the ballot July 17 with no challenge filed and is the only opponent to Sen. Camera Bartolotta (R). State Navigate Oct 3 to 5 poll: tied 43 to 43 with leaners.

Main challenger is independent Rebecca Prendergast, not a Democrat. The State Navigate Oct 10 to 14 poll already in the inventory (D None, R 49) should be completed as: Craig Staats (R) 49, Prendergast (I) 46, DK 5 with leaners (initial 47, 42, 10); 514 LV, MoE 4.3. Set main_challenger_party to I and D to 46.

Republican primary winner Tyler Bowen moved out of state and was ruled ineligible and removed from the ballot on Aug 10. The Wayne County GOP picked Gordon Ramey II as the replacement nominee against former Del. Ric Griffith (D). Open seat.
Incumbent Elliott Pritt (R, party switcher from D) was arrested on federal charges in July. The race is now six-way with no Republican on the ballot.
Incumbent Chuck Smith (R) withdrew, handing the nomination to DJ Perry (R), who faces Democratic Socialist Isaiah Harris in a Trump +14 seat.
Republican committees dropped nominee Ann Reinhart over court records, but she remains on the ballot against Democrat Pittman, who lost a 2024 Senate race by 31 votes.
An 18-year-old independent, Lex Goff, is the main challenger to Bill Rhiley (R) in a Trump +41 district.
Republican nominee Michael Carroll withdrew over an arrest record. He was replaced by Will Gifford (R, age 21), who faces Democrat Francis Lombard.
Incumbent Brett Easterbrook (R) was arrested and left the race. Replacement John Knapp (R) faces independent Elaine Beech, a former incumbent, who is the main challenger.
Independent Allan Fung (former Cranston mayor) is running against Republican Chris Paplauskas and Democrat Colleen Crudele in a Trump +9 seat, splitting the conservative vote.

Peri Pourier, a former Democrat now registered Republican, is running as an independent for the open Senate seat against Anthony Kathol (R) and Celestine Stadnick (D). Four independents, including the decertified Democrat Elizabeth Lone Eagle, are running for the LD-27 House seats against Liz May (R).
Incumbent Ron Alting (R) has stepped back from campaigning amid a shoplifting investigation and health concerns but remains on the ballot against Natasha Baker (D).
Democrat Shelly Headen lost her party's support after social media posts surfaced but remains on the ballot against John Blust (R).
No names were on the primary ballot after the incumbent's petition fell one signature short. The general election is effectively a write-in race, and the sore loser rule blocked Kyler Gilkey.
Incumbent Elle Cochran switched from Democrat to Republican. She faces Democrat Sne Patel and Green Party candidate Paele Kiakona.
A Republican-only primary rerun, Kanani Souza vs Sheila Medeiros, was ordered after an 842 to 842 tie decided by lot was voided by the state Supreme Court.
Independent Max Hanna is on the ballot with Democrat Danielle Bass and Republican Kelly Kitashima for the seat vacated by Michelle Kidani. Source is Wikipedia, not independently confirmed.
Rep. Elliott Engen (R) filed for reelection after abandoning statewide bids, then withdrew from the House race. Source is Wikipedia, replacement nominee not confirmed.

Candidate Alex Barclay withdrew on 8/28/2026, the general election withdrawal deadline, per the Oklahoma State Election Board withdrawal list. Party and effect not stated. Oklahoma HD-92 general election was cancelled, with one candidate elected unopposed.
Democratic candidate Kim DeLaney died Jan 26, 2026 before the primary. Thomas Monks is the Democratic nominee. Source is Wikipedia.
Incumbent Mike Clampitt (R) died Mar 18, 2026. Appointee Anna Ferguson is the Republican nominee against Mark Burrows (D). Source is Wikipedia.

Incumbents Nasif Majeed (HD-99) and Carla Cunningham (HD-106) lost renomination and then left the Democratic Party to become independents. It is not confirmed whether either is on the November ballot. Source is Wikipedia.

Independents are on the Assembly ballot: Shena Chapman (AD-36 vs Jeffrey Mursau), Rachael Dowling (AD-53, open), Tiffany Brault (AD-60, open), Josh Kelley (AD-69 vs Karen Hurd), and Paul Michael Weber (AD-95 vs Jill Billings). It is not verified whether any of them is the main challenger. Source is Wikipedia.
Open seat after Joe Tate retired: Willie Burton (D) vs Michele Lundgren (R). Danetta L. Simpson filed paperwork to run as an independent. Source is Wikipedia.
Rep. Khyl Powell (R) dropped his reelection bid for health reasons in March 2026, before the primary. Source is Wikipedia, citing a Mar 9 report.
